headline: Ireland Strategic Investment Fund Commits €75 Million to Housing Venture
summary: The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund committed €75 million to a €169 million residential housing joint venture with property manager Ardstone and CBRE Investment Management.
why: The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund is Ireland's sovereign investment vehicle designed to support economic activity.

impacts.name: Ireland
impacts.why: ISIF committed €75 million to fund a residential housing partnership.
